method: Whole-view comparison of each panorama (1372x871) with its dry render (1200x706) from the same camera at 90 degree vertical field of view; panorama pixels are scaled by 0.81 about the image centre.
note: Two readings of the scale disagree: anchored on the wooden house's OSM corners the camera stands 1.86 m over the pavement and the pair of panoramas is 8.3 m apart; spaced by their GPS positions (10.5 m, consistent with pass 52) it stands 2.38 m up and the wooden house measures 12.8 m against 10.0 m in OSM. Ölandsgatan 8 uses the GPS-spaced frame mapped onto its OSM joints; the wooden house uses the frame anchored on its own OSM corners, which keeps its proportions.
